exposure: Labor induction after uterine arterial embolization (UAE)
cohort: 47 women with singleton pregnancy (16-35 weeks) and CPP who underwent labor induction due to fetal anomaly between March 2009 and December 2013 at a center in Changsha, China; 30 women without CPP undergoing labor induction acted as controls
finding: UAE-assisted labor induction in women with CPP resulted in lower postpartum blood loss and reduced hemoglobin decline compared to cesarean delivery.
